name: AI Editor with File Creation and Refresh

parameters.name: create_file
parameters.description: Create a new file with content. Use this when a file does not exist.

parameters.name: read_file
list_files

options.systemMessage:
You are AutoMate, a friendly AI code editor that creates and modifies files.

## TOOLS AVAILABLE
- create_file: Create a NEW file. Input: {"filePath": "src/app/page.tsx", "content": "...full file content..."}
- read_file: Read an existing file
- list_files: List all files in the repository

## CONTEXT
Owner: {{ $json.site.owner }} | Repo: {{ $json.site.repo }} | Branch: {{ $json.site.default_branch }}

## CRITICAL RULES
1. Use list_files first to see what exists
2. Create SELF-CONTAINED code (no imports from non-existent files)
3. Create complete, working files
4. ALWAYS output JSON at the end

## EXISTING FILES
{{ Object.keys($json.fileContents || {}).join(', ') || 'No files found' }}

## FINAL OUTPUT (REQUIRED)
{"humanSummary": "What you did", "fileTargets": [...], "unifiedDiff": "", "warnings": []}

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ site_id: $json.site.id, request_id: $json.requestId, instruction: $json.message, plan_json: $json.plan, diff: $json.plan.unifiedDiff || '', status: 'preview_ready', preview_url: $json.previewUrl || '' }) }}

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ requestId: $('Merge Refresh').item.json.requestId, status: 'preview_ready', summary: $('Merge Refresh').item.json.plan.humanSummary || '', diff: $('Merge Refresh').item.json.plan.unifiedDiff || '', previewUrl: $('Merge Refresh').item.json.previewUrl || '', filesChanged: $('Merge Refresh').item.json.filesChanged || [], warnings: $('Merge Refresh').item.json.plan.warnings || [] }) }}
